rows.text: The Company expects Net Income per diluted share for the third quarter 2026 will be $0.67, which compares to the previously provided guidance range of $0.13 to $0.15 per diluted share.

Furthermore, the Company expects FFOA per diluted share for the third quarter 2026 will be $0.65, which represents the high-end of the previously provided guidance range of $0.63 to $0.65 per diluted share.
